# bloxone_federation_next_available_reserved_blocks (Data Source)

Retrieves the next available __ReservedBlock__ objects from the specified parent __FederatedBlock__, without allocating them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "bloxone_federation_federated_realm" "example" {
  name = "example_federation_federated_realm"
}

resource "bloxone_federation_federated_block" "example" {
  name            = "example_federation_federated_block"
  federated_realm = bloxone_federation_federated_realm.example.id
  address         = "10.10.0.0"
  cidr            = 16
}

# Preview the next available reserved block(s) under the federated block above, without allocating them.
data "bloxone_federation_next_available_reserved_blocks" "example" {
  id   = bloxone_federation_federated_block.example.id
  cidr = 24

  # Number of reserved blocks to preview. Defaults to 1.
  reserved_block_count = 2
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cidr` (Number) The CIDR of the reserved blocks to be created.
- `id` (String) The resource identifier of the parent Federated Block.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) The description for the reserved block. May contain 0 to 1024 characters. Can include UTF-8.
- `name` (String) The name to be provided.
- `reserved_block_count` (Number) The count of reserved blocks required. If not provided, it will default to 1.

### Read-Only

- `results` (List of String) List of next available reserved block's addresses in the specified parent Federated Block.
